sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs, in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.

sentences.en: And also at The New York Times, this over a new report about a previously unreported meeting at Trump Tower with a foreign country.
sentences.zh: 同时也在抨击《纽约时报》，起因是一篇关于特朗普大厦此前未被报道的一次涉外会议的新报道。

sentences.en: So, The Times published a story over the weekend that looked at a different Trump Tower meeting than the one we've all become familiar with, where Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 因此，《时报》在周末发表了一篇报道，关注的是一次不同于我们所熟悉的特朗普大厦会议，在那次会议上，小唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: This time, the meeting was with officials from Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates.
sentences.zh: 这一次，会见的对象来自沙特阿拉伯和阿拉伯联合酋长国的官员。

sentences.en: And they air discussions with the Trump campaign officials about potentially helping out the campaign.

sentences.en: The reason it matters is because it's the first indication that we have that Mueller is not just looking at whether the Trump campaign worked with Russians during the election season,
sentences.zh: 这件事之所以重要，是因为它释放出了第一个迹象，表明穆勒不仅在调查特朗普竞选团队在选举期间是否与俄罗斯人合作过，

sentences.en: but also whether they may have worked with other foreign governments who were either offering up or actually providing help to Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 还在调查他们是否曾与向唐纳德·特朗普提供或实际提供帮助的其他外国政府合作，

sentences.en: and whether they were also coordinating with the Russians.
sentences.zh: 以及他们是否也曾与俄罗斯人进行协调。

sentences.en: So, it just gives a sense of an avenue that we weren't really aware existed in this investigation of the entire Russia meddling picture.
sentences.zh: 因此，这让我们意识到，在整场俄罗斯干预事件的调查中，存在着一条我们此前并未察觉的调查方向。

sentences.en: So, this is sort of the latest sign that the Mueller investigation continues to expand in its scope.
sentences.zh: 所以，这可以说是穆勒调查范围继续扩大的最新迹象。

sentences.en: And this time, it's literally expanding to entire other countries.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，它的范围实际上已经扩大到了其他整个国家。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it may well be that Mueller has been looking down this avenue for quite some time, but it's just now that we're getting wind of it.
sentences.zh: 很可能穆勒关注这个方向已经有一段时间了，只是我们现在才听到风声。

sentences.en: And every time one of these things becomes public, the president gets another little bit of a glimpse of how big this investigation really is,
sentences.zh: 每当这些事情公开时，总统就能再次隐约窥见这项调查究竟有多么庞大，

sentences.en: how much Mueller and his team really know.
sentences.zh: 穆勒和他的团队究竟掌握了多少情况。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's just continuing to go on and on.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这一切还在没完没了地继续下去。

sentences.en: And that makes the president extremely angry, and it makes him want to lash out.
sentences.zh: 这让总统极为愤怒，也让他想要猛烈回击。

sentences.en: Let me read you what he has just tweeted.
sentences.zh: 让我读一下他刚刚发出的推文。

sentences.en: Things are really getting ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 事情真的变得越来越荒谬了。

sentences.en: The failing and crooked, but not as crooked as Hillary Clinton,
sentences.zh: 那个正在失败且腐败、但还没希拉里·克林顿那么腐败的

sentences.en: New York Times has done a long and boring story indicating that the world's most expensive witch hunt
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》发表了一篇冗长而无聊的报道，暗示这场世界上最昂贵的政治迫害

sentences.en: has found nothing on Russia and me, so now they are looking at the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 在俄罗斯和我身上没有查到任何东西，所以他们现在把目光转向了世界其他地方。

sentences.en: But interestingly, he didn't take issue with anything in the story.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，他并没有对报道中的任何内容提出异议。

sentences.en: He didn't call it fake news.
sentences.zh: 他没有称其为假新闻。

sentences.en: And there's a pause of a few hours, and then he tweets again, and he says, I hereby demand, and will do so officially tomorrow,
sentences.zh: 几小时的暂停后，他又发了一条推特，他说，我在此要求，并将于明天正式提出，

sentences.en: that the Department of Justice look into whether or not the FBI slash DOJ infiltrated or surveilled the Trump campaign for political purposes.
sentences.zh: 要求司法部调查联邦调查局（FBI）斜杠（Slash）司法部（DOJ）是否为了政治目的渗透或监视了特朗普竞选团队。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, for a long time now, he has been complaining about the fact that we know that several of his campaign officials were wiretapped.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很长一段时间以来，他一直在抱怨一个事实，即我们知道他的几位竞选官员被监听了。

sentences.en: But the more recent factor for the president that has him talking about whether his campaign was infiltrated
sentences.zh: 但对于总统来说，另一个更近期的因素让他开始谈论他的竞选团队是否被渗透，

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》和《华盛顿邮报》报道称，联邦调查局曾派出一名线人去跟特朗普竞选团队的几名成员交谈。

sentences.en: According to the reports, the FBI did indeed send an informant to talk to three Trump campaign advisers after receiving evidence that they had suspicious contacts with Russia.
sentences.zh: 根据报道，在收到他们与俄罗斯有可疑接触的证据后，联邦调查局确实派出一名线人与三位特朗普竞选顾问进行了交谈。

sentences.en: The informant, who, according to the Washington Post, was a retired American professor, interacted with Trump campaign members George Papadopoulos, Carter Page, and Sam Clovis.
sentences.zh: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，这名线人是一位退休的美国教授，他与特朗普竞选团队成员乔治·帕帕多普洛斯、卡特·佩奇和萨姆·克洛维斯进行了接触。

sentences.en: When this first came out, the president was really angry and talked about how inappropriate it was, and he alleged that the person was a spy that was planted in his campaign.
sentences.zh: 当这件事最初曝光时，总统非常愤怒，谈到了这有多么不合适，并指控此人是安插在他竞选团队里的间谍。

sentences.en: We've come to learn through reporting of my colleagues here in the D.C.
sentences.zh: 通过我在这里的华盛顿

sentences.en: Bureau that the reason that these informants were sent in was because they had uncovered contacts
sentences.zh: 分社同事们的报道，我们了解到，派这些线人进去的原因是他们发现了

sentences.en: that Trump campaign officials had with Russians, and they wanted to look into what they were.

sentences.en: And further, there was a sort of political timing motivation here, not in the way that the president is representing it, that they were out to get the campaign,
sentences.zh: 此外，这里面还有一种政治时机方面的动机，并不是像总统所描绘的那样，是冲着搞垮竞选团队去的，

sentences.en: but they were close enough to the election that they didn't want the spectacle of doing a big FBI interview of these people,
sentences.zh: 而是因为当时距离大选已经很近了，他们不希望搞出一场大阵仗去对这些人进行联邦调查局式的面谈，

sentences.en: ask some questions and see, was there really anything to this, or were they going down a wrong path?
sentences.zh: 问一些问题，然后看看这背后到底有没有问题，还是说他们走错了方向。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's not as if they were double agents who went and applied for jobs on the Trump campaign so they could spy on people.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这并不是说他们是去特朗普竞选团队应聘工作的双面间谍，好去监视别人。

sentences.en: They were doing the work that an FBI informant often does, where, you know, you get a meeting with
sentences.zh: 他们做的是联邦调查局线人通常会做的工作，也就是，你知道的，设法与

sentences.en: someone, you go to dinner with them, you talk to them, you try to get information out of them that's in a less overt way than you would in a face-to-face interview saying,

sentences.en: And is there a reason for the president to be outraged by this arrangement, given that this was happening under a Democratic president and in the middle of a very heated
sentences.zh: 考虑到这件事发生在一位民主党总统任内，并且正值一场竞争极其激烈的总统竞选期间，而他当时正与希拉里·克林顿对决，总统对这种安排感到愤怒有理由吗？

sentences.en: presidential campaign as he's running against Hillary Clinton?
sentences.zh: 我觉得这位总统对整场调查有着极度的偏执，所以他坚信自己有充分的理由对此产生怀疑。

sentences.en: I think this president is very paranoid about this whole investigation, so he believes there's a very good reason to be suspicious.
sentences.zh: 这发生在奥巴马担任总统期间，所以他随后便认为这在某种程度上是由

sentences.en: But, you know, it's very typical to have an informant in a big investigation like this, or several informants.

sentences.en: it's just not the way these things typically work.
